title: Vee widget card
description: The JSON payload a Vee plugin prints when it is invoked with VEE_TARGET=widget. A card is either one of five preset templates or a composable layout tree. See https://vee.navbytes.io/guide/widgets.html

template.description: Which preset template draws the tile. Ignored entirely when `layout` is present. An unknown value falls back to `stat` with a diagnostic.

title.description: Tile heading — the plugin or metric name.

symbol.description: SF Symbol name for the glyph.

value.description: The headline value, already formatted by the plugin.

status.description: Drives styling and the health roll-up. An unknown value is ignored with a diagnostic.

progress.description: The `gauge` template's fill. Clamped to 0…1; a non-finite value is dropped.

trend.description: The `trend` template's series. Non-finite entries are dropped.

actions.description: Up to two are rendered as buttons. There is deliberately no `shell` action: a widget button must not run an arbitrary command without the menu's context.

url.description: For `kind: href`. Scheme-filtered like a menu `href=` — http/https and app deep links only, never file: or javascript:. A blocked or unparseable URL drops the action with a diagnostic.

name.description: For `kind: shortcut` — the macOS Shortcut's name.

refresh_after.description: Seconds; a hint for the next widget reload.

stale_after.description: Seconds; when the tile should show a stale treatment.

layout.description: A composable layout tree. When present it replaces `template` entirely.

node.description: One node of the layout tree. Containers carry `children`; leaves do not. The tree is capped at 8 levels deep and 64 nodes; anything beyond is dropped with a diagnostic.

type.description: An unrecognised type renders nothing and produces a diagnostic.

symbol.description: For `image` nodes — an SF Symbol name (v1 renders SF Symbols only).

values.description: For `sparkline` nodes. Non-finite entries dropped; truncated at 256 points.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment. vstack: leading|center|trailing (default leading). hstack: top|center|bottom (default center). zstack: topLeading|top|bottom|leading|trailing|center (default center). An unrecognised value falls back to the default.

families.description: Widget sizes this node renders in. Absent means all of them — one tree adapts by subtraction.

style.description: Per-element styling. Every numeric value is clamped.

size.description: A semantic text style. Anything else falls back to body.

point_size.description: An explicit size. Wins over `size` when both are set. Clamped.

design.description: Anything else is the default face.

monospaced_digit.description: Fixed-width digits — stops numeric columns jittering between refreshes.

min_scale.description: Minimum scale factor: lets a headline shrink to fit rather than truncate. Clamped.

fill.description: Grow to fill the available width. The only width control — arbitrary point frames are deliberately not exposed.
